book.name: 2 CORINTIOS
book.title: 2 CORINTIOS Corinto marcacho tag waugui-panicunaman apóstol Pablo guepa cag cartata apatsishgan

content: Cuyay waugui-panicuna, Tayta Dios tsaynog niycämaptintsega ama ima jutsatapis rurashuntsu, ni lutan yachatsicuytapis ama chasquipäshuntsu. Tayta Diosta respitar pay munashgannogla imaypis cawashun.
Corintucho cag waugui-panicuna Pablo tantyatsishganta chasquicushgan
Waugui-panicuna, yarparcalämay, ari. Gamcunata manami maygayquitapis saqueashcätsu ni lulapashcätsu ni engañashcätsu.
Gamcunata tsaynog niycä manami manacagman churartsu. Naupata nishgänogpis gamcunataga imaypis mana gongaypami yarparaycäshayqui.
Cananga musyänami apatsimushgä cartata liyir tantyatsishgäcunata chasquishgayquita. Tsaymi imanog nacarpis mana jagayänatsu ni laquicönatsu. Tsaypa trucanga cushishgana cawaycä.
Runacuna chiquipäcamaptin y gamcuna conträ sharcushgayquita yarpachacur Macedonia provinciaman chayashgäpita-patsa
Imanog captinpis cuyapäcog Tayta Diosnintsi manami imaypis gongantsu payman yäracogcunataga. Tsaymi laquishga caycaptë gamcuna cagpita Tito chämuptin cushicushcä.

Manami Tito chämushgalanpitatsu cushicushcä, sinöga cartacho tantyatsishgäta chasquicushgayquita wilamaptinmi cushicushcä. Paymi wilamashga gamcunaman watucog shamunäta munarcaycashgayquita y nogapag laquicurcaycashgayquitapis. Tsaynog wilamaptin masragmi cushicushcä.

Apatsimushgä cartata liyir laquicunayquipag cashganta musyarmi nogapis laquicorgä. Tsay cartacho tantyatsishgäcunata ali chasquishgayquita Tito wilamaptinnami itsanga laquicunäpa trucanga cushicushcä.
Manami gamcunata laquicatsishgäpitatsu cushicushcä, sinöga Tayta Dios munashgannogna cawarcaycashgayquita musyarmi cushicushcä.

Waquincunaga jutsa rurashganta tantyacurpis rätulapagmi laquicärin. Laquicushpanpis manami jutsancunata cacharintsu. Tsaynog cagcunataga Tayta Diosnintsi manami perdonangatsu. Jutsa rurashgancunata cachariptinnami itsanga Tayta Dios perdonangapag.

Gamcunaga cartächo tantyatsishgäcunata liyir laquicurpis tantyacärishcanquimi Tayta Dios munashgannogna cawanayquipag. Tsaymi cananga munarcaycanqui watucog shamunäta. Conträ sharcog runacunatapis gamcuna michashcanqui wasäta rimar mana purinanpag. Tsaynog cashgayquita musyarmi noga cushicö.
Tsay apatsimushgä carta manami conträ sharcog runata corriginalayquipagtsu cashga, sinöga gamcunapis tantyatsishgäcunata chasquicur cäsucunayquipagmi.
Tantyatsishgänogla cäsucamashgayquita musyarmi cushicö. Titupis cushishgami cutimushga yachatsishushgayquita ali chasquicäriptiqui. Tsaynog cushishga cutimuptinmi nogapis masrag cushicushcä.
Manarag gamcuna cagman Tito shamuptinmi payta shacyätsergä “Paycuna alimi chasquishunquipag” nishpä. Tsay nishgänoglami lapanpis camacashga.
Cananga Titupis gamcunapag yarparaycan yachatsishushgayquicunata cushishga chasquicur cäsucärishgayquipitami.
Tayta Dios munashgannog cawashpayquimi cananga yäracuypagna carcaycanqui.

footnotes.text: Macedonia provinciaman apóstol Pablo aywashganpita musyanayquipag liyinqui 2 Corintios 2.13.
